intent: A non-modal inspector dialog, docked beside the inspector rail, that hosts one video color-adjustment group — Light, Color, Color wheels, or Creative — as labelled slider rows, a color wheel, and a segmented control.
guidance: Structure only — controls sit at neutral defaults and nothing is wired to the grade pipeline. It commits live (no Apply): pass `controlledKeys` + `values` for the engine-backed sliders and read `onValueChange`, and let every other key keep its internal cosmetic state. `onModifiedChange` reports deviation from neutral defaults so the collapsed inspector row can show 'Modified'. The anchored body unmounts on close, so value state lives on the always-mounted wrapper. Set `enabled={false}` (Color section not added) to render every control disabled. It anchors its side axis to the inspector surface's left edge, so it clears the rail at any panel width — don't hand it a trigger-relative offset.

anatomy.description: 40px header showing the group title; it also serves as the dialog's drag handle.
X icon button (aria-label "Close") at the header's right edge; dismisses the dialog. There are no footer actions — changes are live.
The group-specific control stack, inset 12px on all sides; unmounts when the dialog closes.
Repeated control: a caption label, a neutral or gradient-track slider, and a trailing 52px numeric value field.
Color-wheels group only: Shadows / Midtones / Highlights tabs above a 140px color wheel, then range/saturation/brightness sliders.
Creative group only: an Off / Luma / RGB segmented control sitting between the two slider blocks.

use_when: Fine-tuning a bound clip's grade in one of the four groups — Light, Color, Color wheels, or Creative.
Deep adjustments too numerous for the inline Color section, opened as a dedicated anchored surface.
dont_use_when: Choosing or authoring a fill/stroke/text color — use the color/fill dialog (ColorDialog).
A blocking, focus-trapping confirmation — use Modal.
A single control that fits on the inspector row — keep it inline.

slots.trigger: The control the dialog launches from and re-focuses on close; captured and rendered full-width.

states: modified (emitted via onModifiedChange when a group control leaves its neutral default)

tokens.note: Type sizes are hardcoded, not type tokens (title text-[11px]/font-[550]; row label text-[9px]/font-[450]/leading-[14px]/tracking-[0.05em]). The Color group's slider tracks use hardcoded hex gradients (e.g. Temperature #3b82f6→#ffffff→#f59e0b; Hue #f00→#ff0→#0f0→…), so the component is not fully token-bound.

a11y.role: dialog (non-modal — rendered on the Popover content with aria-label set to the group title; aria-modal=false and focus is not trapped, so the canvas stays reachable).
a11y.dismiss: Escape closes; a labelled Close (X) button in the header also closes. Outside interaction is not blocked by default.
a11y.controls: Each numeric value field is labelled `<Label> value`; the color wheel is labelled `<tab> color wheel`; the noise segmented control is labelled 'Noise type'.
